# Dear ImGui and ImPlot names

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_names.py: do not edit -->

Each public function of Dear ImGui and of ImPlot, linked to its declaration in the header FIGURE is built with ([imgui.h](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/blob/d88f238d1d363ef387382b2e29ad12cf96f826ac/imgui.h), Dear ImGui 1.93.1 WIP, docking branch; [implot.h](https://github.com/epezent/implot/blob/72de27832d1e6299bcc930ce01073d899d420392/implot.h), ImPlot 1.2 WIP), and the FIGURE calls that reach it. FIGURE exposes 172 of the 376 Dear ImGui functions and 58 of the 134 ImPlot functions. A reader of Dear ImGui's or ImPlot's documentation finds here the FIGURE name of what they read about; the [feature map](features) lists FIGURE's calls, and each reference section names the upstream functions it wraps.

- A FIGURE call is listed when it calls the function, directly or through the library's own procedures: `ig_scroll_here` reaches `SetScrollHereY` (and `SetScrollHereX` with `axis='x'`). A call listed against several functions combines them (`ig_begin_popup_context` is `BeginPopupContextItem`, `BeginPopupContextWindow` and `BeginPopupContextVoid` by its `on` argument); one that reaches a function only for its own bookkeeping is listed too.
- **raw only:** no FIGURE call reaches it. The C name is the function's binding in the raw modules (`figure_cimgui`, `figure_cimplot`), which are internal to the library ([Raw bindings](raw-bindings)): a program needing one asks for a wrapper. **not bound:** variadic or taking a callback, skipped by the raw layer.
- Functions behind `IMGUI_DISABLE_OBSOLETE_FUNCTIONS` and `IMPLOT_DISABLE_OBSOLETE_FUNCTIONS` are left out: FIGURE is built without them.

Generated by `scripts/gen_names.py` from cimgui's and cimplot's metadata, the library's sources and the native glue; `python3 scripts/check_docs.py --names` fails when this page is not current.
